Everything in this project has been tested in a quiet room with a scripted or acted patient. That is not a clinic.

What is your setting, and what about it would this not survive? Background noise, a third person in the room, a patient who talks across the doctor, a cheap microphone, a machine without a 24 GB card, anything else you can think of.

If you have tried it, what actually happened.

You do not need to have run it to answer this. A clinician's account of why it would not work where you work is just as useful to me.
